about: The hints the titles carried until order 92 (D-185), one per title, read by tt_hint (retired). Kept as they were.

hints.blooded: The old soldiers have a word for a boy who comes out of his first battle bleeding and still on his feet. They do not say it to everyone.
hints.unbought: In the market they say there are men a purse cannot move, and that such men get a name for it. Mostly, they say it of the dead.
hints.ironhide: There is a name, they say, for a man who has been cut open and sewn shut so often that the surgeons know his scars by heart.
hints.undefeated: The soldiers have a name for a man who has never lost a fight. You have not heard it said of you.
hints.breaker-of-champions: In three realms, they say, the champions go quiet when a certain kind of man comes to town. There is a name for him.
hints.hundred-day-wall: Old garrison men talk of a place that stood a hundred days and more, and of what they called the one who held it.
hints.peacemaker: Envoys say there is a name for one who has ended more wars at a table than most men have fought in the field.
hints.silver-sage: Scholars speak of an old teacher whose pupils became masters in their turn, and of the name the schools gave him.
hints.faithful-unto-death: The priests tell of the faithful who were offered the door of a cell for one word against their god, and would not say it.
hints.beast-bane: Hunters speak of someone who goes after beasts stronger than any hunter should face, and comes back, again and again. They call that one something.
hints.sword-of-the-realm: Every realm, they say, has one blade the crown calls its own. The name passes when its bearer dies, never before.
hints.wyrm-slayer: In the mountain villages they keep a name for the one who kills a dragon, and they say it is held by one living soul at a time.
hints.sword-saint: Old soldiers say the Saint will name no heir: the sword, they say, will know the next one when he is gone, and not before.
